# Northstar Digital Studio

> Northstar Digital Studio is an independent software engineering and digital product studio founded and led by Rahul Garg. The studio designs, architects, and builds production-ready SaaS platforms, enterprise workforce intelligence tools, native desktop companion apps (Electron + TypeScript), full-stack applications, and scalable digital architectures.

## Core Services

- **Web Development**: Fast, accessible, high-performance websites built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and modern responsive design.
- **MERN & Full-Stack Applications**: Scalable architectures built with MongoDB/PostgreSQL, Express/FastAPI, React, and Node.js.
- **SaaS Product Engineering**: Multi-tenant cloud platforms featuring row-level security, tenant isolation, billing integration (Stripe), and role-based access control.
- **Native Desktop Companion Apps**: Cross-platform desktop tools built with Electron, TypeScript, Vite, system tray background execution, global HUD shortcuts, and offline queue synchronization.
- **Workforce Intelligence & Telemetry**: Privacy-first employee focus monitors, automated application classification, and real-time productivity scoring complying with GDPR Article 15/17.
- **UI/UX Design & Design Systems**: Considered interfaces, design systems, and usable prototypes that translate product goals into high-impact digital experiences.
- **Technical SEO & Growth Architecture**: Structured data graphs (Schema.org), Core Web Vitals optimization, and crawl-optimized architectures.

## Flagship Products & Work

- **AetherDesk Tracker**: Enterprise workforce telemetry & desktop SaaS platform with real-time activity tracking, automated screenshot telemetry with privacy masking, multi-tenant organization workspaces, and WebRTC live view.
  - Stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Vite, Electron.
  - Live Demo: https://comparable-bill-ltd-phones.trycloudflare.com
  - Source: https://github.com/rahulgarg55/aetherdesk

- **BugTracker & Desktop Companion**: Multi-tenant engineering defect and sprint management SaaS with an instant Electron HUD hotkey (Ctrl+Shift+B) and offline queue resilience.
  - Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, Electron.
  - Source: https://github.com/rahulgarg55/bug-tracker

- **ProductivityFlow Desktop Agent**: Real-time workforce focus telemetry agent that classifies foreground application activity into productive, distracted, or idle states, computing live focus scores with FastAPI sync and GDPR compliance.
  - Stack: Electron, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, SQLite WAL.
  - Source: https://github.com/rahulgarg55/productivity-tracker

- **ReportIQ**: AI-assisted client reporting platform for digital agencies, synthesizing Google Analytics and time-tracking data into automated executive summaries.
  - Live URL: https://report-iq-topaz.vercel.app/
